children: Porsche India on Tuesday announced the inauguration of its new Service Centre in Kolkata, strengthening the brand's after-sales capabilities in Eastern India with advanced technical infrastructure and dedicated electric vehicle repair facilities.
Developed by Porsche India's dealer partner, Bird Group, the new facility is the largest Porsche after-sales centre in the country.
Spanning more than 32,000 square feet, the state-of-the-art facility has been designed in accordance with Porsche's latest global Corporate Identity standards, the luxury automaker stated.

"The inauguration of our largest aftersales facility in India reflects our continued commitment to strengthening Porsche ownership experience and expanding our service capabilities across the country," said Ashutosh Dixit, Head of Porsche India.

"We are proud to inaugurate this new facility, which represents an important step forward in our commitment to Porsche customers in Kolkata and across Eastern India," said Gaurav Bhatia, Dealer Principal of Porsche Centre Kolkata.
A key highlight of the new service centre is its advanced electric vehicle repair infrastructure, including a dedicated high-voltage repair area and specialised battery repair capabilities.

Porsche Service Centre Kolkata is the only facility in Eastern India equipped to undertake dedicated Porsche battery repairs, further strengthening the brand's ability to support its growing electrified vehicle portfolio, the company said.

title: Porsche India inaugurates its largest after-sales facility in Kolkata
